method.normalization: Local files are compared with upstream blobs at the pinned revisions. Normalization strips leading and trailing whitespace, blank lines, lines that are only brackets or separators, and import and re-export statements (JS/TS and CSS); comments are kept. Comparison runs on CRLF-normalized text so a checkout line-ending change is not reported as a difference.

metrics.diffLines: Symmetric normalized line difference against the upstream file (added plus removed). It is 0 exactly when the two normalized line sequences are equal.
metrics.localOnlyLines: Normalized lines present in the local file that are not matched in order upstream.
metrics.longestRun: Longest run of consecutive local normalized lines that occurs consecutively upstream.
metrics.substantiveLines: Heuristic count of local-only lines that are neither comment-only lines nor explainable as formatter artefacts (trailing semicolons or commas). Review aid only; it is not a threshold and no threshold was changed.

method.conclusionRule: identical: byte-identical to upstream after CRLF normalization. zcode-modified: an upstream counterpart exists at the pinned revision but the file differs from it. no-upstream: no upstream file with that basename exists at the pinned revision. Per the plan's default ruling, anything that is not byte-identical is recorded as zcode-modified rather than registered as third-party content.
method.upstreamSelection: For shadcn, all 99 upstream commits that touch the four registry ui directories between 2025-06-01 and ZCode's 2026-09-21 snapshot were compared; see the deliverable document for the full scan. For ai-elements, VS Code and Material Icon Theme the repository's recorded referenceRevision was reused and re-verified. For Fig the recorded GitHub revision was checked against npm release metadata.
method.upstreamCache: External bare clones of the pinned upstream revisions were kept outside the repository under a local cache directory; no upstream object store or tree is committed to this repository.
